insights.title: Curve gradient,derivative notation and rational-power/chain rules
insights.teaching_comparison: YM begins with two-sided chord/tangent interpretation,then optional first-principles work,derivative notation,power/sum rules,changed variable and explicit chain rule. Try5Q1requires two methods and an agreement check. Goldie2&3assumes this background and opens its differentiation chapter with product/quotient rules,also showing expansion as a check. An expandable product inYMdoesnot automatically assess Mathematics2product rule;an explicit product-rule instruction inGoldie does.
insights.examination_comparison: NSSCAS2021P1Q12(d)and2023P1Q11anchor rational-power differentiation;2025P1Q8(a)asks a point gradient. Conceptual chord observations and notation panels are teaching support beyond a correct derivative formula. Source-enforced method comparison requires actual evidence of both routes;an answer alone cannot demonstrate it.
insights.difficulty_and_grade_bounds: E08explicitly names gradient and first/second derivative notation and excludes first-principles differentiation. C08/A08permit rationalpowers and chain rule,with product/quotient not required inMaths1. Difficulty comes from rewriting,innerfunction choice and original real domains,not simply a large exponent. The source all-real-power statement must not enlarge rational-power scope.
insights.pitfalls: YMTry7Q1prints an off-curve point but the intended-inputgradient is correct;Example10has a denominator-cleared falseparameterpair. A fourthroot(-4x)needsnonpositivexanditsfinite derivative strictnegativex. These are source/author cautions;no frequency is inferred from them. Notation preference against negativepowers is not an official marking prohibition.
insights.gaps_and_representations: YM supplies the core introductory progression;Goldie gives advanced-rule variants and alternative expansion checks. A supplied derivative task needs no unasked reconstruction of the curve. Pointwise ordinate and derivative value must remain separate outputs.
insights.implications_for_step3: Propose original-expression/domain retention,requested differentiation-variable/order metadata and prescribed-method evidence. Keep the optional limit derivation separate from assessable tasks. Independently verify derivative formulae and point incidence,not just a key number.

insights.title: Tangents,normals,angle conventions and monotonic intervals
insights.teaching_comparison: YM separates tangent,normal,given-gradient lines,intercept geometry,positive-axis inclination and acute tangent angles. Its derivative-sign tasks progress from linear sign inequalities to disconnectedrationaldomains and extremal branchendpoints. Goldie applies the same line/stationary ideas to rational,e/lnandtrigfunctions and explicitly includes longer connected normal/intersection/area chains. Method sophistication alone doesnotchange which geometric evidence is asked.
insights.examination_comparison: NSSCAS2021P1Q11(b)and2024P1Q13(a)anchor tangent/normal construction. The mappedNSSCASsamplehas no usable direct monotonicity part;the syllabus demand remains with textbook/comparable evidence rather than being dropped. A line-intercept or angle extension is broader than simply giving the tangent. The source’s positive-axis inclination is not the acuteangle between two lines.
insights.difficulty_and_grade_bounds: E08already names tangents,normals,increasing/decreasing functions;C08/A08retain linked applications. Harder tasks infer a point from intersections,distinguish maximalinterval from strictderivativesignset,or use a normal later. Horizontal/vertical exceptions and connected domaincomponents matter more than coefficient size.
insights.pitfalls: YM13’swrongtangent/normal lines stillpass through the correctpoint;direction checks are essential. Try12Q4has literalstem/keyconflict. Example18’srationalmonotonicity must be read per connectedcomponent;Try18Q2has an isolatedzerogradient without negativegradient. These are registered source cautions,not claims that an automated image view provescorrect marking.
insights.gaps_and_representations: Both books support analyticlines;YM offers explicit inclination and maximal-domain branches. An isolatedzero derivative doesnotautomaticallybreak strictincrease. Source given versus solution graphs cannot be silently interchanged.
insights.implications_for_step3: Propose checking incidenceANDslope,explicit tangent/normal/angleconventions,and connected-domainmonotonicity. Retain a normalreintersection or perpendiculardistance as a structural branch with its own final quantity. Keep the sampled monotonicitygap visible.

insights.title: Signed direct/connected rates and motion interpretation
insights.teaching_comparison: YM distinguishes directtime models,forwardchainrates,inverse rates and inferredpositions,then displacement/velocity/acceleration. Goldie’s exponentialriverheight and later advancedcalculus contexts apply different standard derivatives to the same rate logic. A geometryformula supplied in the task is not an independently assessed modelderivation;atankdepth relation that must be derived is.
insights.examination_comparison: NSSCAS2022P1Q12(a)(b)anchors connectedrates;2023P1Q10(a)(b)motionderivatives;2025P2Q11(c)aninstantaneous time rate. Textbook sphere/circle units,inverseposition branches and tanks broaden inputs. The same finalchain multiplication doesnotmake different modelderivations the samewhole task.
insights.difficulty_and_grade_bounds: E08/C08/A08all include rates and motion. Difficulty increases through signedinputrate,inverse derivative/nonzerorateconditions and geometrybeforecalculus. Large source-model velocities are not evidence of real-world plausibility or a higher grade.
insights.pitfalls: YMTry22Q1prints cm/sinstead ofcm²/s;Example24needs a nonzero cancellation qualification. Negativevelocity is not speed,and negativeacceleration alone is not always deceleration. These source/author distinctions are not automatically examiner-evidenced misconceptions;ERR03concerns initialconditions more broadly in linked motion work.
insights.gaps_and_representations: Both books supply time/ratecontexts;YM systematically separates forward and inversechains. Model quantities have different unitpowers. A decrease should remain a signedrate unless the prompt explicitly requests its positivemagnitude. Context realism and mathematical validity are separate checks.
insights.implications_for_step3: Propose quantity/timeunit metadata,sign-aware inputs,nonzeroinverseconditions and originalratechecks. Retain modelbefore-rate scaffolds where asked. Keep velocity/speed and displacement/distance distinctions explicit in future marking/feedback.

insights.title: Stationary classification,inflexions and geometry-specific optimisation
insights.teaching_comparison: YM separates locate/nature/sketch chains,stationaryinflexions,abscissa-only/given-derivative tasks and inverse graphconstraints before optimisationmodels. It explicitly changes objective/constraint between fixedvolume-area and fixedsurface-volume. Goldie extends stationary analysis to rational,e/lnandtrigfunctions and connected tangent/intersectiongeometry. Both permit valid alternative naturetests where the questiondoesnotprescribeone.
insights.examination_comparison: NSSCAS2021P1Q11(a)anchors stationaryclassification;2023P1Q13(a)(b)anchors modeloptimisation. A supporting derivative drilldoesnotcover required geometrymodelling. The syllabus includes inflexions even though post2020Cambridge9709doesnot;those demands and source evidence must remain. A requested sketch or no-ordinateinstruction is preserved at partlevel.
insights.difficulty_and_grade_bounds: C08/A08explicitly locate and distinguish maximum,minimumandinflexion. E08supplies applicationbackgroundwithoutrestatingallclassification. Difficulty grows with inconclusivesecondderivative,domainfiltering,hidden graphconstraints and derivingthe rightgeometryobjective. Gradeparameterdomains waitforstep3.
insights.pitfalls: YM27copies a wrongcoordinate sentence beside a correctgraph;29needs more thanf″=0;Try31Q4uses touchingrootDatgraphlevel. Example34misnames a minimumasmaximum;cone radiusfalseleadswerecleared;some keyblocks are swapped under wrongheadings. These aresource defects,cautions and clearedleads,not interchangeablelearner errors.
insights.gaps_and_representations: Textbook modelbreadth goes beyond a generic finalquadratic derivative:closedcuboid,open tank,cylinder,inscribedcone,Lshape,curvedplate,sharedfences and foldedcardhave different constraints. Optimisingthegradientfunction inRevision6Q4changes the target entirely. A source’sunasked sketchornaturecheck is not an assessed response.
insights.implications_for_step3: Propose retaining model-specific givens,face/arc/sharedboundary counts and feasiblepositive domains. Check stationarycandidates against endpoints/degeneracies and requestedtargetquantity. Keep source-required natureproofs/sketches and label any future additional marking as author-derived until reviewed.
